item.title: ICE Detained a Venezuelan Soccer Pro: A Case Highlighting Immigration Backlog Crisis

item.title: 5 Exercises to Prevent and Relieve Pregnancy Pain
item.description: Hemorrhoids, leg cramps, sciatica — oh my! Along with pregnancy's joy often comes physical discomfort. Alleviate and prevent common aches with these exercises.

item.title: Afghan interpreters who aided U.S. troops now fear losing green card status
item.description: Five years after the U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan, many Afghan allies resettled in America are anxious about their immigration status.

item.title: Powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake off Indonesia kills at least 38
item.description: A strong earthquake near Indonesia's coast early Saturday caused at least 38 deaths and damaged buildings.
